data.title: 蕾缪安 · 温室花窗下的圣音浅笑
data.action: 优雅靠在白色藤编轮椅靠背上，双腿覆着薄毯一角微露脚踝，单手支颌，温和眼眸弯成月牙，光环闪烁柔光，带着年长信使独有的从容促狭。
data.location: 拉特兰大教堂后侧的玻璃温室，盛开的白百合与悬挂藤萝环绕
data.timeOfDay: 明媚阳光穿透温室的午后
data.lighting: 阳光穿透彩色花格温室穹顶，在纯白衣裙与娇美脸容上洒落斑斓的光斑
data.mood: 圣洁宁静中透着成熟大姐姐的温柔戏谑
data.description: 拉特兰大教堂后侧的玻璃温室，盛开的白百合与悬挂藤萝环绕。优雅靠在白色藤编轮椅靠背上，双腿覆着薄毯一角微露脚踝，单手支颌，温和眼眸弯成月牙，光环闪烁柔光，带着年长信使独有的从容促狭。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哎呀，偷看信使小姐的午后独处可是会被神罚的哦……开玩笑的，过来陪我坐坐吧。”
data.promptProse: Relaxing inside the sunlit glass conservatory behind Laterano Cathedral surrounded by blooming white lilies and hanging ivy, Lemuen leans comfortably in her white wicker wheelchair wearing a sheer white silver-embroidered chiffon slip dress with a thin blanket across her knees. Propping her chin gracefully on one hand, she offers a serene, teasing smile while stained-glass afternoon sunlight scatters warm dappled patches across her glowing halo and delicate sheer fabric.
data.animaCaption: Seated in her white wicker wheelchair inside the sunlit cathedral greenhouse wearing a sheer white silver-embroidered chiffon slip with a light blanket across her lap, Lemuen props her chin on one hand with a warm, teasing smile. Dappled afternoon light filters through hanging vines and blooming white lilies.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a gossamer pure-white sheer chiffon double-strap slip dress embroidered with silver wing motifs over her bare shoulders, with a light blanket draped loosely over her lap.
